fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The trust seeks to achieve its investment objective by holding a portfolio of the common stocks that are included in the index (the “Portfolio”), with the weight of each stock in the Portfolio substantially corresponding to the weight of such stock in the index.

news.paragraph: The S&P 500 experienced a volatile week, sinking on June 10th amid fears of war, only to bounce back with tech stocks the following day. Energy stocks have shown significant strength year-to-date, with the IYE up 27%. However, a notable warning signal from Bank of America suggests caution for investors, and a decision by Kevin Warsh on June 16-17 may influence market direction.
